DataOrigin.description: Where a study or artifact came from.
DataOrigin.title: DataOrigin

source_ref.description: Where the label came from, e.g. 'train.csv' or 'rules v0.2'.
source_ref.title: Source Ref

notice.default: Shows what influenced the model score; it does not localise an injury.
notice.title: Notice

slice_index.description: 0-based index in the series' slice order.
slice_index.title: Slice Index

n_unknown.description: Excluded from every metric; never counted as negative.
n_unknown.title: N Unknown

threshold.description: Validated operating threshold, if one exists.
threshold.title: Threshold

checkpoint_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the checkpoint file. None only for fixtures.
checkpoint_sha256.title: Checkpoint Sha256

trained_on.description: Dataset ID and partition; None for fixtures.
trained_on.title: Trained On

allow_cached.description: Serve a matching cached result instead of running live.
allow_cached.title: Allow Cached

findings.description: Subset of the active profile; None means all.
findings.title: Findings

code.description: Machine-readable code, usually an ErrorCode value.
code.title: Code

message.description: Plain-language explanation safe to show to a reviewer.
message.title: Message

computed_at.description: When the scores were originally computed.
computed_at.title: Computed At

latency_ms.description: Wall time of this live run; only for source=live.
latency_ms.title: Latency Ms

ResultSource.description: How a prediction was produced. Never relabel one as another.
ResultSource.title: ResultSource

plane.description: None when the plane could not be determined.

rendered_width.description: Width in px of PNGs from the slice endpoint.
rendered_width.title: Rendered Width

SliceOrder.description: How slice_index 0..n-1 was ordered for a series.
SliceOrder.title: SliceOrder

notice.default: Dataset labels are for evaluation only. They are never used by the model.
notice.title: Notice

info.description: Knee MRI research review prototype. Not for diagnosis. Contract schema 0.1.0.
info.title: KneeScope API

get.description: Ready to serve: the study catalogue loads (KS-API-02 adds checkpoint checks).
